data.title: 椎名真由理 · 仰望夜空的星之指引
data.description: 神社阶梯的高处，真由理举起单手伸向无垠的夜空，仿佛要将远处的星辰握在手心。回过头来时，晚风轻轻吹起她的帽檐，露出清澈治愈的温柔微笑。
data.location: high stone stairs of a quiet Tokyo hillside shrine overlooking twinkling city lights
data.action: standing atop stone steps, reaching one arm high toward the starlit Milky Way, turning back with a serene heartwarming smile as wind flutters blue hat
data.lighting: luminous starlight and distant amber streetlamp glow illuminating clear blue eyes
data.mood: pure celestial wonder, comforting innocent devotion, timeless nostalgic warmth
data.promptProse: Reaching one hand toward a sparkling starry sky on temple steps, Mayuri turns around with a gentle loving smile under the cool night breeze.
data.animaCaption: She turns back with one arm raised toward the Milky Way; the nearby streetlamp softly lights her face and hat.
